title: 20,000km Canal Project: A New Vision for Water Management
excerpt: Tarique Rahman pledges to revive the nationwide canal-digging program to combat waterlogging and boost agriculture.

content.text: Addressing a technical seminar, the BNP Chairman outlined a massive infrastructure plan to dig 20,000 kilometers of canals across the country to solve urban waterlogging and rural irrigation issues.
The plan also includes a 'Green Revolution' goal to plant 250 million trees over the next five years to restore the country's ecological balance.
My father, Ziaur Rahman, showed that voluntary labor and canal digging can transform a nation's landscape. We will modernize this vision to tackle 21st-century climate challenges.
content.author: Tarique Rahman, BNP Chairman

title: BNP to Support 'Yes' Vote in February 12 Referendum
excerpt: Aligning with its 31-point reform agenda, the BNP officially announces support for the constitutional referendum held alongside the general election.

content.text: BNP has officially instructed its activists to campaign for a 'Yes' vote in the upcoming referendum, which aims to decentralize power and limit prime ministerial terms.
The party highlighted that many of the proposed reforms, including the creation of an Upper House of Parliament, were originally part of the BNP's 31-point state repair outline.
We are voting 'Yes' because we believe in a system of checks and balances where no single individual can ever become an autocrat again.
content.author: Mahdi Amin, Adviser to BNP Chairman

title: Tarique Rahman Launches National Campaign from Sylhet
excerpt: Upholding a decades-old party tradition, BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman begins the 13th Parliamentary Election campaign from the land of 360 saints.

content.text: BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman formally launched the party's election campaign at the historic Alia Madrasa ground in Sylhet. Following the footsteps of Shaheed Ziaur Rahman and Begum Khaleda Zia, he began the journey by offering prayers at the shrines of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) and Hazrat Shah Paran (R).

We are starting this journey from this holy land to restore the people's right to vote. This election is not just about a change in power, but about returning the ownership of Bangladesh to its citizens.
content.author: Tarique Rahman, BNP Chairman

content.text: The rally saw a massive turnout, with supporters traveling from across the division to hear the Chairman's first public address outside Dhaka in over two decades.

title: Global Connectivity: PayPal and IT Parks for All
excerpt: BNP promises to integrate Bangladesh into the global digital economy by bringing PayPal and providing free workspace for freelancers.

content.text: During an interaction with Gen-Z voters in his Dhaka-17 constituency, Tarique Rahman promised to remove barriers for freelancers by finally bringing platforms like PayPal to Bangladesh.
The proposal includes establishing specialized IT parks with free Wi-Fi and working spaces, funded through a unique advertisement-supported model.
Our youth shouldn't just be job seekers; they should be global earners. We will provide the tools, the internet, and the banking access they need to compete with the world.
content.author: Tarique Rahman, BNP Chairman

title: From Shanty to Safety: Permanent Housing for Urban Poor
excerpt: Tarique Rahman visits Korail slum, promising high-rise apartments and legal ownership for long-term residents.

content.text: In a targeted campaign stop at Mohakhali, Tarique Rahman addressed the residents of Korail, promising to replace makeshift shanties with permanent high-rise apartment buildings.
The plan involves registering small apartments in the names of current dwellers, ensuring they have legal title to their homes and access to basic utilities.
I am a son of this area. I have seen your struggles. If elected, we will ensure that the people of Korail no longer live in fear of eviction, but in the dignity of their own homes.
content.author: Tarique Rahman, BNP Chairman
